cartInfo: Simply shop, add items to your cart, and go to checkout.
checkoutInfo: Choose Sezzle at checkout. You'll be redirected to sign up or log in to complete  your order.
ctaHeader: Manage Your Orders, Reschedule Payments, and Shop Deals
description: Select Sezzle at checkout and split your entire order into 4 payments over 6 weeks.
logoAltText: Sezzle: The responsible way to pay
longTerm: Monthly installments available for orders over $150. Terms 3 months – 48 months and APRs will vary depending on credit qualifications, loan amount, term, and lender.  Subject to credit approval by a third party lender.
review1Description: Love Sezzle, it helps when you're doing a project and need that extra time to pay.
review2Description: Wonderful. I mean why not? 4 payments!! Buy now and pay later!
shipmentInfo: Your order will be shipped out right away<sup>2</sup> and your payments will be  split up over 6 weeks.
subDescription: When you select Sezzle at checkout, you are choosing The Responsible Way to Pay.
term1: Pay in 4 payment option is 0% Annual Percentage Rate (APR). 25% down payment then three payments of 25% every two weeks for 6 weeks.
term1noServiceFee: Pay later loans are originated by WebBank or Sezzle. Refer to your loan agreement for lender information. For example, for a $300 loan Pay in 4, you make one $75 down payment today, then three $75 payments every two weeks totaling $300.00 in payments.
term2: Pay later loans are originated by WebBank or Sezzle. Refer to your loan agreement for lender information. For example, for a $300 loan Pay in 4, you would make one $75 down payment today, then three $75 payments every two weeks for a 45.0% annual percentage rate (APR) and a total of payments of $307.49 which includes a $7.49 Service Fee (finance charge) charged at loan origination. Service fees vary and can range from $0 to $7.49 depending on the purchase price and Sezzle product. Actual fees are reflected in checkout.
term2noServiceFee: A fee may be incurred for rescheduling payments. Please refer to Account Disclosures.
term3: Options depend on your purchase amount, may vary by merchant, and may not be available in all provinces.
term4: Shipping times subject to merchant shipping policy.
